description: Implementation of LatentMoE,Toward Optimal Accuracy per FLOP and Parameter in Mixture of Experts (Elango et al., NVIDIA 2026) — in Pytorch. A single-file, dependency-light layer you can drop in place of a standard MoE FFN.
